become.title: Become a manager
become.subtitle: Create your own on-chain strategies, grow TVL, and earn fees from the people who invest alongside you.
become.note: Open to anyone. No application or approval needed.

step1.title: Build a strategy
step1.body: Pick a Uniswap v3 pool, set its price range, and define your fees.

step2.title: People invest
step2.body: Investors deposit USDC alongside you. The position is pooled and managed together.

step3.title: You earn fees
step3.body: Earn a share of the trading fees your strategy generates, plus the fees you set.

empty.title: No strategies yet
empty.subtitle: Create your first Uniswap v3 strategy to start earning fees from the people who invest alongside you.

dashboard.subtitle: Here's how your strategies are doing

share.title: Share your strategies
share.body: Invite people to invest alongside you.

mandate.title: Mandate
mandate.subtitle: The mandate is your strategy's fixed scope: the network and Uniswap v3 pool it runs on. Once you launch, it is permanent and cannot be changed.
mandate.poolSearch: Search by pair, token or pool address
mandate.rangeFullNote: Full range: earns across all prices, never needs a Move Range.
mandate.derivedNote: You don't set these. Pool Party derives them from your pool and range.
mandate.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the strategy's thesis, what it does and who it's for.
mandate.tokenHint: Pick a token to see its available pools.

review.title: Review & launch

fees.title: Your fees
fees.subtitle: Set your performance fee: a share of the LP fees your strategy generates. Entry, exit and management fees are coming soon.
fees.performanceHint: {min}–{max}% of generated LP fees · no high-water mark
fees.performanceError: Performance fee must be between {min}% and {max}%.
fees.entryInfo: A one-time fee charged on each deposit into the strategy.
fees.exitInfo: A one-time fee charged when an investor withdraws.
fees.managementInfo: An annual fee on assets under management, accrued continuously.
fees.performanceInfo: A share of the LP fees the strategy generates (10–90% in v1). No high-water mark.

access.title: Access
access.privateSoon: Allowlist, NFT and password access are coming soon.

review.verifyingNote: Checking the pool exists and your parameters are valid.

live.title: Your strategy is live
live.body: {name} passed verification and is now listed for investors.
live.bodyChain: {name} is now live on-chain and listed for investors.

draft.title: Draft saved
draft.body: {name} was saved as a draft. Launch it anytime from your console.

failed.title: Verification failed
failed.body: We couldn't verify this strategy. Check the pool and parameters, then try again.
failed.bodyChain: The transaction failed or was rejected. No funds were moved. Check your balances and try again.

seed.title: Seed liquidity
seed.subtitle: Deposit the first liquidity into your pool. You provide both tokens.
seed.subtitleSingle: This range only needs {symbol}, deposit it to seed your pool.
seed.error: Couldn't load your balances. Refresh and try again.
seed.minUsd: Minimum to create a strategy is {amount}

zeroBalance.title: You need {token}
zeroBalance.body: Your wallet has no {token}. Add some to seed your pool, then come back to launch.

review.creatingNote: Confirm the transactions in your wallet. This deposits your seed liquidity and creates the pool on-chain.

metadata.failed: Your pool is live on-chain, but saving its details failed.
metadata.createFailed: We couldn't save your strategy details. Please try again.

externalLink.title: You're leaving Pool Party
externalLink.body: This link goes to {domain}, an external site we haven't verified. Continue?

operate.title: Live position
operate.outOfRangeNote: This position is out of range and isn't earning fees. Move the range to resume.
operate.gasNote: You pay the network gas for these actions (~{amount}).
operate.error: Something went wrong. No funds were moved.
operate.empty: No live position for this strategy yet.
operate.moveRangeDesc: Set a new price range for the position.
operate.slippageHint: Cancels the rebalance if the price moves more than this.
operate.reviewAssurance: The position is moved without investors needing to touch the strategy's funds.

strategies.title: Managed strategies
strategies.subtitle: All your strategies in one place. Filter by status and manage each one.

empty.all: You haven't created any strategies yet.
empty.drafts: No drafts. Save one from the strategy builder.

manage.notFound: We couldn't load that strategy. Try again.

performance.title: AUM
performance.noHistoryBody: AUM history will appear after this strategy's first days of activity.
performance.snapshotNote: Shown AUM is the live pool value; the chart tracks the daily snapshot, so the two can differ slightly.

range.outNote: The price left your range, so this position stopped earning fees. Move the range to resume.

operations.title: Operations
operations.showInExploreNote: List this strategy on the public Strategies page. Off means link-only.
operations.pauseConfirmBody: New deposits stop. The position keeps running and investors can still withdraw.
operations.resumeConfirmBody: Investors will be able to deposit into this strategy again.
operations.closedNote: This strategy is closed. Deposits are frozen; investors can withdraw anytime, instantly and with no fee.

draft.title: This strategy is a draft
draft.body: Finish setting it up in the builder to launch it for investors.

remove.title: Withdraw
remove.desc: Choose how much to withdraw from your strategy.
remove.closeAlert: Withdrawing more than 50% closes this strategy and withdraws all your liquidity and collects accrued fees.
remove.dustAlert: This would leave less than $5, so the strategy will close.
remove.closeFeesNote: Withdraws all your liquidity and collects accrued fees.
remove.investorsNote: All investors' liquidity is removed and becomes available to withdraw at any time.
remove.confirmBody: This strategy will close and all investors' liquidity will be removed and available to withdraw at any time. Continue?

close.footerLocked: ≈ {amount} · Arrives in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} · per strategy lock-up

confirm.compoundBody: Reinvests this position's uncollected trading fees back into the position to keep earning.
confirm.pauseBody: Blocks new investments into this strategy until you resume. Current investors keep their position and withdrawals stay open.
confirm.closeBody: Unwinds the position and ends the strategy. Investors keep their funds and withdraw instantly with no fee. This can't be undone.
confirm.launchBody: We verify the pool and your parameters, then list the strategy publicly. You sign the transaction and pay the network gas.

banner.label: Banner
banner.help: 2048×1152 recommended (16:9). Keep key content in the center safe area. Edges crop on smaller screens.

photo.help: Square, at least 400×400. Opens the crop tool.

profileTab.autoList: Your public strategies are listed on the profile automatically.
profileTab.mediaUploadFailed: Couldn't upload the image. Try again.
profileTab.saveFailed: Couldn't save your changes. Try again.
profileTab.handleLockWarning: Your handle is permanent. You can't change it after saving.

crop.help: Drag to reposition. Keep key content inside the safe area.

validation.nameMin: Display name must be at least {min} characters.
validation.handleInvalid: Choose a handle with 3-30 letters, numbers or hyphens.
validation.linkWrongNetwork: That's not a valid {network} link. Add your {network} handle.

verify.pendingHelp: We're reviewing your request. This usually takes a few days.

modal.title: Verification requested
modal.body: Your verification will be evaluated by our staff. Please send us a message through your registered social media to the Pool Party official profile containing the following code: {code}.

verify.reshowError: Couldn't load your code. Try again.

build.title: Build your strategy
build.subtitle: Assemble your Uniswap v3 liquidity position. Select a node to configure it.
build.paletteNote: V1 uses a fixed flow with one pool per strategy. More blocks unlock later.

config.title: Configure node
config.allocationNote: 100% of strategy capital. One pool per strategy in V1.
config.tickNote: Bounds snap to the pool's tick spacing.
config.rangeError: Max must be at least 2 ticks above min.
config.monoAssetWarning: Close to the current price. A small move may require both tokens to seed.
config.autoMoveNote: Rebalance the position when price exits the range.
config.removeNote: V1 strategies hold exactly one pool, so this node can't be removed.
config.depositBody: Investors enter with USDC. Deposits are zapped into the pool's tokens automatically.
config.swapBody: USDC is swapped into {tokens} to match the pool's composition.
config.collectBody: Trading fees accrue to the position. Collect them to your balance or compound them back in. You pay the gas.
